title: DividendExpectation
description: obs.dividend_expectation r1: one answer about the expected dividend of one instrument on one day (IBKR generic tick 456); append only, an error is a row and a later success is a new attempt. IBKR does not say declared or projected, so every ex-date is projected.

session_day.description: Session day (XNYS) the row answers for.

instrument_id.description: Instrument (IBKR contract id) the row answers for.

attempt.description: Attempt number of the day, from 1; a later attempt never replaces an earlier row.

issuer.description: The issuer text of the watch list: cik:<10 digits>, or edinet:<code>.

status.description: present: the tick gave a parsable next ex-date and amount; no_value: the tick gave none (a non-payer or no answer in time); unsupported: the market failed its probe and is not asked; error: the request failed. Only present carries next_ex_date and next_amount.

past_12m.description: Dividends per share of the past 12 months as decimal text; null when the tick gave none.

next_12m.description: Dividends per share expected in the next 12 months as decimal text; null when the tick gave none.

next_amount.description: Next dividend per share as decimal text; null unless status is present. The key is always present.

next_ex_date.description: Next ex-dividend date, projected; null unless status is present. The key is always present.

currency.description: Currency of the contract asked, not a claim of the tick; empty when none.

error_code.description: Error code when status is error; empty otherwise.

source.description: Where the row came from; none is a status unsupported row, since no source produced it. Never null.

received_at.description: Instant the row was produced, UTC.
